requirements:
msrest
xmltodict
requests
docutils
azure-cli
azdev
sphinx
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Azure CLI environment ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with detected imports and azure-cli/azdev for full Azure CLI functionality. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies, and includes a placeholder CMD that can be customized based on specific use case.
